verdict.rationale: Fivetran ships an official MCP server that lets users issue natural-language queries and commands (e.g., checking sync status, triggering write/delete operations, copying connections) and provides AI coding-agent plugins (Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, Copilot CLI) that let users build/test/deploy connectors via natural-language prompts. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of the MCP server's reliability, and no native built-in chat/NL interface inside the Fivetran dashboard itself beyond the AI support assistant.
